transfer_and_power_conventions.physical_vector: v_rel(K)=-i Khat Vrel_signed_s(K,z) zeta_unit(K), fixed Fourier convention. One LOS component filtered by original W(K R16).
transfer_and_power_conventions.original_same_state_LOS_sigma: sigma_los_s=sqrt(original E9 R16 cumulative Vrel² W² to K=.10 /3), must also independently recompute with same 180 KVEL grid and compare original E9 at fixed z.
transfer_and_power_conventions.long_density_wind_cross_per_logK: Define real signed C_s(K)=Dcdm_s(K)*Vrel_signed_s(K)*W(KR16)/sigma_LOS_s, so Delta^2_{delta_c,r_s}(K) = +i (Khat dot n) C_s(K) for cross <delta_c(K)r_s(-K)> under the stated Fourier convention. Observable galaxy long bias remains unknown.
transfer_and_power_conventions.squeezed_Gamma_product: Define Bhat_ell,s(K;kshort=.05,z=.95)=Gamma_ell,s * C_s(K), per unit [DeltaBias*Pcb(short)] and per unit long CDM-density dimensionless covariance, before the +i cos(K,LOS) geometry and physical 2pi²/K³. The actual squeezed bispectrum also requires proper momentum triangle, halo/tracer kernels, finite-window and nuisance modeling.
transfer_and_power_conventions.two_point_odd_mean: Still zero under original symmetric Gaussian velocity model. Nonzero Bhat is NOT a nonzero unconditional eBOSS xi.
